note: Compiler-owned receiving API plus canonical AST lineage reconciliation. This fragment does not promote the repository-wide String/array/collection/AST phase gates.

mappings.source: javac task plus M3 shared frontend contract
mappings.target_rule: Additive exported compiler SPI; not a rename of one of the distinct stored AST families
Task Context owns callbacks, source seals, loader and projections; no java.base runtime dependency
Existing com.synexia.m3index.M3AST wraps this lineage; do not equate it to indexstring documents
Existing parser owner now accepts retained source and actual compiler unit; private optional bridge consumes it
Preserve lazy weighted LRU, isolated pools, load deduplication and explicit cache ownership
Existing file/SQLite codec and replay; cache miss requires live compiler input in shared bridge
No claim that the workspace owner has been transplanted into java.base
Retained spelling/occurrence file plane remains distinct from the compiler decoded-character seal
Raw bytes and coordinate mappings are not represented by the UTF-16 character hash
Version-matched same-loader conversion; guarded complete attribution and pre-lowering input; no new parser
